summary: Mason Mages, 13, of Windsor, drowned at Rock Bridge Lake when strong winds overturned the canoe he shared with his 8-year-old brother; the brothers had canoed to an island and were returning to shore when winds came up; Windsor Severance Fire Rescue arrived to wind gusts exceeding 45 mph.
notes: Storm-wind canoe capsizing fatality; 2020-05-07 (Thursday-verified); insert run 872; parent-verified against Coloradoan article
